quote: What are you searching for in the dark? When shadows only stretch as you draw near. We chase ghosts of who we used to be, forgetting that rivers never flow the same way twice. Every memory fades into the quiet dust of yesterday. So why do you keep knocking on locked doors? When the rooms inside are already empty.
